title: Bitcoin Fee Index (EU): Total Cost of Buying Bitcoin
description: EU-licensed Bitcoin buy routes ranked by total cost, listed fee plus estimated spread, for monthly buying. Fees checked {date}, with sources.
og_title: Bitcoin Fee Index: what buying Bitcoin really costs
lead: We compare EU-licensed Bitcoin buy routes by total cost (listed fee + estimated spread) for monthly buying.
disclosure: Virtuse may earn a referral fee. It doesn't change the ranking.
spread_note: Est. spread: for Bybit EU and Kraken Pro, a market buy of that amount against the public BTC/EUR order book (average fill against the mid price), measured {date}. For 21bitcoin, which has no public order book, its buy price in the app against Kraken's mid price at the same minute, measured {date}.
excluded: Not included: network and withdrawal fees, and currency conversion if you don't pay in euros. 21bitcoin charges its regular fee (0.99%, 0.79% with a referral code) for the first 7 days of a plan.
finding: At {amount} a month, {w} has the lowest total cost ({wt}), followed by {s} ({st}).
s1_p: The fee each partner publishes for this route at the entry tier, from the partner's own fee page.
s2_p: What you pay above the market's mid price when the order fills. We measure it rather than assume zero.
s3_p: Fee plus spread, as a share of each buy. Per year means 12 buys of the chosen amount.
q1: What does the Bitcoin Fee Index rank?
a1: EU-licensed routes for buying Bitcoin every month, ranked by total cost: the listed fee plus the estimated spread, at €50 to €1,000 a month.
q2: Why isn't a 0% fee automatically the cheapest?
a2: A route can charge no fee and still price Bitcoin above the market. That's why we add the estimated spread to the fee before ranking.
a3: No. Network and withdrawal fees, and currency conversion if you don't pay in euros, are not included. They depend on how and when you move your Bitcoin.
q4: How often are the numbers checked?
a4: We check the fee pages and measure the spreads every quarter, and whenever a partner changes its prices. The date at the top shows the last check.
